source_strata.selection: All eligible pairs; date held fixed across providers, provider held fixed across dates.
source_strata.interpretation: Provider and date labels come from the author. Matched JSD exposes distribution variation; these are not endpoint-independent identity accuracy or causal provider effects. Missing strata remain ineligible.

mixture_stress.pairing: Sorted enrolled labels, nonoverlapping adjacent pairs; no selection by outcomes.
mixture_stress.mixture: Two held-out valid answers from each label per intact cell, 50:50; not a real gateway experiment.
mixture_stress.interpretation: A single nearest label or passing gate cannot establish a single upstream model, nor identify a routing mixture.
